IncidentBot: pagerduty: HIGH - hosted-inference-prod: 5xx-rate spike (>10% p90) — escalation policy 'prod-inference' has fired. Primary on-call: Sam (oncall) paged.
Sam (oncall): got it, I'm on mobile, looking at rate graphs now.
Sam (oncall): hmm, can see 5xx from model-v2 nodes, 30s window shows steady increase.
Sam (oncall): trying quick `kubectl logs` on inference-deploy-prod, network looks ok.
Sam (oncall): paging for backup, might need to scale or failover to model-v1.
PagerDuty: Alert incidentid=INC12345678 | triggered to Sam (oncall) — no ack within 2m — escalating to Aisha (secondary).
Aisha (secondary): acked — jumping in. on my laptop, can someone open a bridge?
Tom (platform): opening bridge now — https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/INC12345678 (added to incident channel) :link: 
Maggie (SRE): I got a manager page as well (escalation to manager). I can join bridge in 2. Need quick impact summary in channel.
Luis (support): customer-facing: we have 3 customers reporting errors for embedding endpoints, support ticket ids: #8732, #8739. Latency also up ~2x.
Aisha (secondary): looking at logs — KV-cache misses are spiking during longer sequences, causing timeouts, and there's a backend 502 bubbling up. snippet: ```
[2024-05-12T14:02:11Z] inference-v2-03 | ERROR | kvcache miss -> fallback path -> upstream timeout (1.5s)
[2024-05-12T14:02:13Z] inference-v2-01 | 502 POST /v1/generate  -> backend: grpc: connection reset
```
Aisha (secondary): runbook shows two mitigations: 1) increase pool up, 2) route traffic to v1 read-only variant. I'll try traffic switch first.
Sam (oncall): I'm still on mobile, can we temporarily mute PD alert noise? it's spamming our phones while we coordinate.
Tom (platform): I can suppress the PagerDuty rule for this alert for 10m via console. command: ```bash
pdctl alerts mute INC12345678 --until 2024-05-12T14:25:00Z
```
Tom (platform): muting now — done. PagerDuty: suppression applied.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: suppression applied by Tom (platform). Manager escalation remains active until incident ack-handling completes.
Maggie (SRE): why did manager get paged? Wasn't Aisha acking?
Aisha (secondary): I acked, but I got a follow-up PD manager escalation because the on-call didn't confirm bridge join in the SLA window. PD policy requires manager after no bridge confirmation.
Maggie (SRE): ack — joining bridge. Also will reach out to product for customer comms.
Luis (support): suggested customer message draft: "We're seeing increased errors on embedding endpoints; mitigation in progress; no data loss; ETA 15-30min" — want signoff? :thinking:
Sam (oncall): approve the message, go ahead. Add that we're failing over to a stable variant.
Aisha (secondary): switching traffic weights to v1 read-only: ```json
{ "routes": [{"model":"model-v2","weight":20},{"model":"model-v1","weight":80}] }
```
Aisha (secondary): applied change via console API, results look good — 5xx rate dropping on v1, overall error rate falling.
Tom (platform): also scaled inference-pool-prod from 40 -> 60 to soak load. command: `infra scale pool inference-pool-prod 60` — CPU/GPU utilization stabilizing.
Sam (oncall): confirmed via dashboards: p95 latency back within SLO, 5xx under 1.5% now. Good.
PagerDuty: manager escalation (Maggie (SRE)) acknowledged.
Maggie (SRE): joining bridge — quick notes: we need a follow-up check on KV-cache eviction policy and sequence-length demotion. File a postmortem please.
Aisha (secondary): filing a short incident report rn, will include root cause hypothesis: model-v2 path has higher KV-cache churn with recent quantization patch, leading to fallback timeouts at peak sequence lengths.
Luis (support): customer comms sent to impacted customers with ticket refs.
Sam (oncall): thanks all. I'm going to transition to post-incident handoff to oncall follow-up tomorrow.
Tom (platform): unmuting PD alert rule (auto) set to re-enable after 10m.
IncidentBot: Incident INC12345678 status: mitigated -> assigned to followup. Postmortem owner: Aisha (secondary).
Maggie (SRE): action items: (1) rollback quantization patch for v2 or gate by traffic; (2) tune KV-cache eviction to reduce churn; (3) add smaller-window synthetic tests to catch this before prod; (4) review PD escalation thresholds for bridge-confirmation. I'll add these to the ticket. :clipboard: 
Sam (oncall): thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
Aisha (secondary): closing on my side too, will drop the postmortem link here when ready.
Luis (support): noted. customers updated and monitoring for any regressions.
